resources.string: When enabled, the system will force-stop selected target apps when they are launched from selected caller apps. This can work around emulator crashes when an app is relaunched while it is still running.
Tick the apps that are allowed to trigger Launch Guard. These apps must be included in persist.gammaos.launch.guard.callers.
Tick the apps that should be force-restarted when launched by a caller app. These apps must be included in persist.gammaos.launch.guard.targets.
